name: 16\" Sausage & Pepperoni Deli Pizza, 30.5 oz
description: Make the end of the day a true celebration when you bake up Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen 16\" Sausage & Pepperoni Deli Pizza for dinner. Each slice of this pizza pie is loaded with pepperoni slices and Italian sausage crumbles for a perfectly savory bite every time. Enjoy it with a refreshing beer or soda for a tasty combination.

name: Sea Salt Caramel Chocolate Chunk Cookie Dough, 16 oz
description: Making delicious and festive treats is easy with this Bake House Creations Salted Caramel Cookie Dough! The ready-to-bake cookie dough is loaded with chocolate chunks and salted caramel pieces. Just break up the cookie dough, pop it in the oven, and enjoy your cookies with a cold glass of milk!

name: Calzone Pepperoni, 7 oz
description: Make tonight's dinner a breeze with this Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen Pepperoni Calzone! The hearty calzone is filled with spicy pepperoni and a blend of creamy mozzarella, parmesan, ricotta, and provolone cheese and topped with golden romano cheese. Just pop yours in the microwave or oven for a tasty and filling meal in minutes!

name: Calzone Four Cheese, 7 oz
description: This Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen Four Cheese Calzone is the perfect dinner for a busy night! The hearty calzone is filled with a blend of creamy mozzarella, parmesan, provolone, and ricotta cheese and topped with golden romano cheese. Dip yours in tangy marinara sauce to put a tasty finishing touch on your meal!

name: Cinnamon Rolls with Icing, 8 count
description: Raise your hand if you're a breakfast fan! Bake House Creations Cinnamon Rolls with Icing comes with 8, ready-to-bake cinnamon rolls. Because these rolls already come with icing, all you have to do is place them in your baking dish and pop them in the oven. Within 12-16 minutes, your cinnamon rolls will be ready to enjoy for breakfast! Pair these rolls with a tall glass of orange juice and some fresh fruit for added nutrition. Discover all of our delicious and affordable bakery and bread options when you stop by ALDI.

name: Jumbo Flaky Biscuits, 16 oz
description: Bakehouse Creations Jumbo Flaky Biscuits are just that: flaky on the outside and fluffy and soft on the inside. These canned biscuits are ready to bake and can be prepared in minutes, but taste as good as traditional homemade biscuits. Top with butter or jam for a classic taste, or pair with savory dishes such as gravy or chicken pot pie. However you choose to enjoy, shop for delicious biscuits, pastries, and more at your local ALDI.

name: Jumbo Buttermilk Biscuits, 8 count
description: These Bake House Creations Jumbo Buttermilk Biscuits are perfectly flaky on the outside and fluffy and soft on the inside. The canned biscuits are simple to prepare -- just pop open the package, lay them out on a baking sheet, and send them into your oven for a few minutes! Top yours with butter and jam for a classic combo, or pair them with savory dishes like mashed potatoes and gravy.

name: Cheesy Breadsticks, 18.75 oz
description: Looking for a quick and easy meal? Look no further. Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen is coming to the rescue in the form of Take and Bake Cheesy Bread Sticks. These breadsticks are made with real cheese, have 0 grams of trans fat, and bake in as little as 7 to 9 minutes. You can enjoy these cheesy breadsticks on your own, dip them in marinara sauce, or top with fresh garlic. Discover all of our delicious and affordable take and bake and deli options at ALDI.

name: 12\" Uncured Pepperoni Cauliflower Crust Deli Pizza, 17 oz
description: Who said veggies weren't delicious? This Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen 12\" Uncured Pepperoni Cauliflower Crust Deli Pizza is made with fresh cauliflower, creamy cheese, tangy sauce, and spicy pepperoni for a tasty bite every time. The certified gluten free pizza is the perfect choice for an allergy-friendly pizza night!

name: 16\" Mega Meat Deli Pizza, 30.5 oz
description: Satisfy the meat lovers in your family with a slice of Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen 16\" Mega Meat Deli Pizza. The pizza pie is loaded with pepperoni, salami, beef, Italian sausage, & bacon atop a 100% cheese blend and crispy thin crust. It's the easy choice for a hearty, delicious dinner when you're short on time -- just pop it in the oven & you'll be good to go within minutes!

name: 12\" Veggie Cauliflower Crust Deli Pizza, 17.6 oz
description: This Mama Cozzi's Pizza Kitchen 12\" Veggie Cauliflower Crust Deli Pizza is the most delicious way to get your vegetables in! The gluten free pizza is topped with a creamy cheese blend, tangy sauces, peppers, onions, and more. Pop it in the oven for a tasty, nutritious meal in minutes.

With an authentic homemade taste and no preservatives added, these ready-to-cook flour tortillas will become your new pantry essential.
